'''R4-T9''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] who instructed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individuals on setting up and maintaining housing.

==Behind the scenes==
R4-T9 first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]" as a quest giver instructing the player on housing. His appearance is the same as [[M1-L0]], another R4-series [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] from the game.
